name: rider-leg
prompt: Use EXACTLY the same hand-painted Korean wuxia (murim) manhwa illustration style as the reference: crisp clean dark outlines, rich soft cel shading, same cream-white robe fabric and gold trim as the reference robe. Draw ONLY the LOWER BODY of a person SEATED ASTRIDE a horse, seen exactly from the SIDE facing RIGHT: starting at the waist sash, the near thigh goes forward almost horizontally, the knee bends, the shin hangs straight down, ending in a plain dark brown leather riding boot with the toe pointing right. The long robe skirt drapes softly over the thigh and falls in vertical folds below the knee on both sides of the leg, the hem fluttering slightly backward. NO horse, NO saddle, NO upper body, NO arms, NO head. Transparent background, nothing else, no text. Keep the robe fabric white/cream so it can be recolored.

name: rider-leg-b
prompt: Use EXACTLY the same hand-painted Korean wuxia (murim) manhwa illustration style as the reference: crisp clean dark outlines, rich soft cel shading, same cream-white robe fabric as the reference. Draw ONLY the lower half of a rider sitting on horseback, pure SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT: waist at top left, thigh forward and level, knee bent ninety degrees, lower leg straight down, dark boot at the bottom pointing right. A wide flowing robe skirt covers the thigh and hangs down past the knee in soft folds. Nothing else — no horse, no saddle, no torso, no head. Transparent background, no text. Keep the robe white/cream for recoloring.
